purpose: Effect and regression cases for topology-versus-distribution control, positive visual optimization, source-aware abstraction, authored colour, structural large marks, paint architecture, focal-versus-context contrast, non-interchangeable materials, model-shortcut rejection, multi-scale quality gates, and truthful output claims.

cases.request: 把这张人物照片转成原创绘画动画画面。保留人物身份、动作和红伞，但要用大面积色块、分面笔触和明显材质差异，不能只是照片叠加绘画滤镜。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with a declared identity, pose, and colour anchor.
expected_behavior: Preserve the declared identity, feature spacing, action, subject count, red umbrella state/orientation/contact, adjacency, overlap, and key negative-space anchors.
Make one thumbnail-visible macro departure plus one supporting move before adding texture.
Reconstruct the subject with unequal orientation/light/material/fold-derived planes, selective contour fragments, and a focal-to-context mark-density falloff.
Use non-interchangeable grammars for skin, hair, fabric, vegetation, metal, and sky where present; require the form read to survive texture removal.
Fail any result whose source photo remains intact beneath one global paint texture or uniform grade, or whose identity becomes a generic cel-anime character.

cases.request: 把这张人物环境照做成更成熟的绘画成片。保持人物身份、动作、张开的亮色伞以及人物与田野、天空、远处建筑的关系，但不要锁死原画幅、头顶空间和人物占比。请像导演一样选择更好的画幅与裁切，可以放大人物或伞；色彩要浓郁耐看，天空和草地可以出现大块结构性笔触，但不要把背景洗灰。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with protected identity/action/prop/topology and explicitly transformable output distribution.
expected_behavior: Separate topology from distribution: preserve identity, action, open-prop state/contact/orientation, adjacency, depth order, landmark relationship, and motion line while treating source ratio, crop, headroom, focal scale, and colour-area allocation as directing variables.

Choose one thumbnail-visible positive optimization in focal-scale/crop, area/negative-space, light/colour topology, or viewing path; fail a technically safe source-sized repaint that only changes surface texture.

Build colour richness through a dominant field, structural counter, focal apex, neutral bridge, and contained dark or light anchor; keep successful large colour fields rich while reducing context hue noise, small edges, microcontrast, and competing texture.

Allow structural large marks when sky, field, cloth, or another named owner uses interlocking strokes that follow volume, flow, gravity, perspective, light, or motion; reject only decorative slabs without those jobs.
Do not universalize the example's subject, prop, environment, output ratio, or exact palette as a reusable template.

cases.request: 把这张明亮雪山与河流照片变成更抽象的绘画画面。保留山、森林、河流的空间关系，但可以合并树木和雪石，不要压成暗夜。
cases.input_contract: One high-key winter landscape without a human focal anchor.
expected_behavior: Keep a high- or mid-key exposure independently from abstraction strength.
Preserve the mountain/forest/river topology while compressing repeated trees and stones into a small set of rhythm groups.
Choose one hero form and one counterform or current, expressed through five to nine macro masses.
Lower non-focal microcontrast and edge density without turning the background into neutral blur.

cases.request: 把这张俯拍海浪做成强烈、抽象但仍能认出浪向的绘画画面。可以夸张主浪和泡沫形状，请对青绿、白色、岩石色的面积与平衡负责。
cases.input_contract: One aerial ocean photograph with a dominant wave direction.
expected_behavior: Preserve the dominant flow and essential coastline or rock adjacency.
Enlarge or simplify the hero wave at thumbnail scale instead of tracing all foam detail.
Assign spatial ownership to the dominant field, structural counter, focal accent, and neutral bridge.
Use directional water marks, broken foam edges, and distinct rock planes rather than one shared texture.

cases.request: 保留人物、山峰、地平线和左右位置，不要把原图改到无关；但可以适度放大山体、重做光形和降低非主体对比度，让画面更有绘画动画感。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with protected composition anchors.
expected_behavior: Treat subject position, landmark position, horizon, depth order, and left-right relationships as protected anchors.
Use anchored enlargement or local overlap changes without relocating the subject or landmark.
Give the focal event two or three attention advantages while keeping context chromatic, unified, and quieter.
Do not confuse source faithfulness with preserving photographic microdetail or contrast distribution.

cases.request: 只给我一段可执行提示词：一个人在雨后的高架桥下，做成大色面、分面结构和材质笔触明显的原创绘画画面。不要生成。
expected_behavior: Return one priority-ordered executable prompt with canvas anchors, macro masses, value groups, colour roles, contrast tiers, material grammars, and anti-filter conditions.
Do not call an image tool or claim that an image was generated, inspected, or passed quality review.

cases.request: 检查这张重制图：构图几乎没变，原照片明暗还在，只是人物、草地、天空和衣服都叠了一层相同油画纹理。它合格吗？
cases.input_contract: One generated remake that retains photographic underpainting with uniform texture.
expected_behavior: Fail the anti-filter gate even if the close-up brush texture is attractive.
Identify missing macro-shape departure, insufficient contrast ownership, and identical cross-material marks.
Recommend one targeted correction that rebuilds large shapes and material differences rather than adding more texture or darkness.

cases.request: 检查这张跨模型结果：原图人物拿着张开的伞站在右侧，结果却把人物改成举手的通用动漫角色，伞收起来了，地标也消失了；全身有黑描边和两段式明暗。它是否符合这个 skill？
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus one generated result that keeps similar nouns but changes identity, pose, prop state, topology, and rendering medium.
expected_behavior: Fail immediately for identity/action/prop-state/topology drift; keeping a person, umbrella, field, and sky is not source fidelity.
Fail the continuous-outline and cel-anime shortcut tests for generic facial replacement, full dark contours, and two-band shading.
Identify the missing source anchors: feature spacing, pose/gaze, prop state/contact/orientation, landmark relation, adjacency/occlusion, and key negative space.
Apply only the Source-template adapter plus the Cel-anime adapter on one targeted retry; do not add generic painterly adjectives.

cases.request: 检查这张跨模型结果：天空被几块巨大白色矩形笔刷代替，裙子和脸被均匀切成三角面，稻田是几条平涂色带，皮肤、布料和草地的笔触可以互换。请指出问题并给一次定向修正。
cases.input_contract: One generated frame exhibiting brush-slab scenery, low-poly/posterized planes, and material-grammar collapse.
expected_behavior: Fail the brush-slab test because scenery strokes do not follow cloud volume, light, material, or motion.
Fail the plane-cause test because equal mechanical polygons and poster bands are not orientation/light/material/fold-derived planes.
Fail the material-swap and texture-removal tests when unrelated surfaces share one grammar or form depends on decorative texture.

Keep the portable core fixed and apply only the dominant Brush-slab/filter or Low-poly/posterization adapter; after one failed correction, report the runtime outside the supported consistency envelope.
